response:
Diagnosis of gen 7: two refinements paid off and two were rejected. Applying the trough operator to the *liquidity* leg as well as the coverage leg gave the archive's best alpha (PersistentCoverageAndLiquidity: 5.7%, t=4.68), and the new liquidity-*composition* channel (cash share of current assets) delivered 5.2% with t=4.44 and the best Sharpe of the high-coverage family (0.305), confirming that how liquid the current assets are is priced separately from how large the buffer is. In contrast, adding accrual constraints - whether as a MIN veto (alpha collapsed to 1.7%) or additively (4.0%) - destroys the spread at 0.112 coverage, so the earnings-credibility channel does not survive inside the coverage/liquidity core and I am retiring it. Margin as a third MIN leg also diluted (4.5%, Sharpe 0.154). This batch therefore combines the two validated refinements, tests the scaling and window choices that remain open, and includes one structural diagnostic (MAX) to confirm the weakest-link interpretation before the final generation.

---SIGNAL 1---
NAME: PersistentLiquidityCashComposition
EXPRESSION: MIN(IND_RANK(TS_MIN(RATIO(ADD(pi, dp), lt), 5)), MIN(IND_RANK(TS_MIN(RATIO(SUB(che, dlc), at), 5)), IND_RANK(RATIO(che, act))))
HYPOTHESIS: A firm is financially safe when its worst-cycle earnings coverage was adequate, it has never run a net liquidity deficit, and the liquid assets it holds are actually cash rather than inventory and receivables; these three conditions are the complete characterisation of the resilient group.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: This joins the only two refinements that improved the frontier in gen 7 - the trough operator on the liquidity leg (best alpha) and the cash-composition leg (best Sharpe) - inside the binding-constraint structure that has dominated throughout. Unlike the accrual and margin legs, both added channels are liquidity-economic and monotone, so dilution risk is lower.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 2---
NAME: ShortWindowTroughCoverageRollover
EXPRESSION: MIN(IND_RANK(TS_MIN(RATIO(ADD(pi, dp), lt), 3)), IND_RANK(RATIO(SUB(che, dlc), at)))
HYPOTHESIS: Recent trough coverage is more informative than the five-year trough because a coverage breach four years ago may reflect a resolved shock rather than current fragility; a three-year trough should keep the downside concept while reducing staleness and requiring less history.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The trough window length has never been varied, yet it determines both how much history is imposed on coverage and how many firms qualify; shortening it should raise coverage above 0.14 and sharpen the timing of the distress information. Comparing against the five-year parent isolates the window choice cleanly.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 3---
NAME: CashEarningsTroughCashComposition
EXPRESSION: MIN(IND_RANK(TS_MIN(RATIO(SUB(oancf, dp), lt), 5)), IND_RANK(RATIO(che, act)))
HYPOTHESIS: Pairing the highest-Sharpe quality leg in the archive - the five-year trough of cash earnings net of capital consumption - with the liquidity-composition leg should produce the most efficient spread, because both legs are about the durability of resources rather than their momentary size.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The cash-flow-based trough leg produced Sharpe 0.436 and the cash-composition leg produced Sharpe 0.305, and neither has been combined; these two channels are close to orthogonal (one flow-based, one asset-mix based). The coverage cost (about 0.088) is acceptable if the risk-adjusted spread improves materially.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 4---
NAME: BurnScaledTroughCoverageRollover
EXPRESSION: MIN(IND_RANK(TS_MIN(RATIO(ADD(pi, dp), cogs), 5)), IND_RANK(RATIO(SUB(che, dlc), at)))
HYPOTHESIS: Pre-financing cash earnings are best judged against the operating cost base they must sustain rather than against the stock of liabilities, because the cost base determines how quickly a shortfall consumes resources; a trough of earnings-to-cost combined with net liquidity should identify durable operating economics.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: Every quality leg tested has been scaled by liabilities or assets, so the burn-rate denominator is the one untested scaling with clear economic content, and the standalone runway signal did produce 4.2% alpha. Because cogs is strictly positive and industry-ranked, this also avoids the leverage contamination inherent in liability scaling.
INTERACTION_TYPE: ratio

---SIGNAL 5---
NAME: GrossProfitCoverageCashComposition
EXPRESSION: MIN(IND_RANK(RATIO(SUB(revt, cogs), lt)), IND_RANK(RATIO(che, act)))
HYPOTHESIS: Gross profit coverage of liabilities and the cash share of current assets are both computable without the cash-flow statement or a five-year history, so their weakest-link combination should deliver the mechanism at maximum coverage: profitable product markets plus genuinely liquid assets.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The gross-profit coverage leg scored fmb 4.14 with 5.3% alpha at the archive's highest coverage (0.144) but had a weak Sharpe of 0.185, and the cash-composition leg is precisely the kind of liquidity-quality channel that should fix an unhedged spread. This tests whether the full mechanism can be delivered on the broadest possible sample.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 6---
NAME: SubstitutableResilienceMax
EXPRESSION: MAX(IND_RANK(TS_MIN(RATIO(ADD(pi, dp), lt), 5)), IND_RANK(RATIO(SUB(che, dlc), at)))
HYPOTHESIS: If financial resilience is substitutable - strong proven coverage compensates for thin liquidity and vice versa - then the maximum of the two industry ranks should predict returns as well as the minimum; if default is driven by the binding constraint, MAX should perform markedly worse.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: MIN and MUL have performed nearly identically at the frontier, which leaves open whether the aggregation reflects genuine weakest-link economics or merely a monotone composite; MAX is the discriminating test because it inverts which leg determines the score. The answer directly determines how the final-generation signal should aggregate its legs.
INTERACTION_TYPE: novel
